picks.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents
picks.why_it_matters: A $130M Series A for a 2024-founded company signals strong investor appetite for enterprise AI agent infrastructure, validating the thesis that companies want to own their agentic AI capabilities rather than rely solely on frontier labs.

picks.title: Former OpenAI exec Kevin Weil is now on the board of Stoke Space
picks.why_it_matters: A top AI executive moving to a reusable rocket startup signals potential convergence of AI talent and capital toward hardware/deep-tech sectors, suggesting new dealflow opportunities in space and adjacent verticals.

picks.title: With EU backing, QuantumDiamonds aims to speed up chip manufacturing
picks.why_it_matters: European Chips Act subsidies are creating a funded runway for deep-tech semiconductor startups, presenting co-investment opportunities in chip infrastructure plays with de-risked early capital from government backing.
